text: [L77] (LOW/path-contract) The binary destination is built by concatenating targetdir and 'bin/' without requiring or adding a trailing separator.
[L57] (LOW/output-escaping) The source path is interpolated into a TeamCity message without escaping service-message delimiters or line breaks.

[L60-L64,L71-L80,L102-L128] (LOW/error-propagation) MPE return codes are repeatedly overwritten without checks, so logging failures can leave undefined event IDs or missing output while numerical execution appears successful.

[L44,L53-L68,L88-L115,L117-L121] (LOW/error-propagation) All MPE status returns are ignored, so event-ID allocation or log-writing failures can remain invisible while the example reports successful numerical output.

[L41-L46,L59-L64,L87-L92] (MED/graphics-handle-portability) Line handles are assigned into arrays initialized as numeric empty arrays, which is incompatible with MATLAB graphics versions that return object handles.
